IOCL Marketing Division NR Apprentices Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) has released the Notification for the post of Apprentice. This recruitment has been issued for 433 posts. Online applying process for IOCL Marketing Division NR Apprentices Recruitment 2026 has started from 07 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 06 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for IOCL Marketing Division NR Apprentices Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 August 2026
  • Last Date : 06 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 September 2026
  • Merit List : Notify Later

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : N/A
  • SC, BC, Female : N/A

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online Trade Apprentice (ITI)
  • Apply Online (Technician & Graduate Apprentice)
  • Apply Online (NATS/NAPS)
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
